# SPD-011 — Reports rendered from events; SessionStart board injection

## Brief
Per the spike ([[SPD-006]]): `spud member finish`, `spud ticket move` and `spud proposal decide` each append a `report.entry` event with a generated line; `spud report add` takes Spud's "Next:" prose; `reports/YYYY-MM-DD.md` is rendered from the day's entries, so the Reports tab of `Board.base` keeps working and Spud stops hand-writing a file the ledger already knows. A `SessionStart` hook (startup, resume, compact) injects `spud board --brief` as `additionalContext`, so the session ritual and the post-compaction re-read happen without being remembered (Law 8).

Depends on [[SPD-007]] and [[SPD-008]]. Decided by Eric, 2026-09-12: reports render from events; Spud types only the Next line (question 7).

Done when: a recorded outcome produces its report entry without Spud typing it, and a fresh session's first message shows the board was injected.

State at start (2026-09-13): the `SessionStart` injection shipped with [[SPD-008]] (`hook_session_start`, matcher `startup|resume|compact`), and this session's first message showed the board, so the second half of Done when already holds; this ticket adds `clear` to the matcher so a `/clear` gets the board too. Reports are already rendered from `report.entry` events, but Spud types every entry with `report add "<title>" --next "…"`.

Decisions (Spud, within Eric's question 7): Spud's own `ticket new`, `ticket move`, `ticket edit --priority`, `member finish` and `proposal decide` each write their generated entry in the same transaction as the record; a nested parent's `member finish` writes none, because report entries are Spud's. Each of those commands takes `--next "…"`, so Spud types only that line. `report add "<title>" --next "…"` stays for what no command records (a merge, an install). Days already rendered stay byte-identical. After the merge Spud runs `spud settings sync` and rewrites CLAUDE.md's protocol step 5 and its Reporting section.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer on opus, the persona's default tier. No Fable on any member, child or probe (Eric, 2026-09-13).
